original_value: A fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for office, creative, and general-purpose use. Features an IPS panel with 2560x1440 resolution, 75Hz refresh rate, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, DisplayPort, and low-blue-light mode. Slim bezels and an adjustable stand make it suitable for multi-monitor setups.
